answer: Latency-Ridge Admission Gate. Each identity must sustain a unique inter-arrival timing profile over a window; agents whose message spacing collapses onto a shared oasis of near-identical intervals get throttled. Enforcement compares interval entropy against a ridge threshold, admitting only profiles with sufficient timing variance. An attacker running N sybils must pay N distinct scheduling delays, since uniform pacing flags the cluster as one ivory-tower artifact and forces costly per-identity jitter shaping.
